d:
Presenting this Sawan Special, the soul-stirring anthem "Har Har Mahadev" in breathtaking 8K from OMG 2, a powerful tribute to the boundless glory, unwavering devotion, and divine energy of Mahadev.
Song: Har Har Mahadev
Music Composer: Vikram Montrose
Singer: Vikram Montrose
Lyrics: Shekhar Astitwa
Choreographer: Ganesh Acharya
Music Supervisor: Azeem Dayani
Associate Music Supervisor: Meggha Vikaas Bali
